name: Doug Collins
summary: Scorer-first 6-6 shooting guard; no defensive honors; sources discuss offense, team defensive lapses in 1977 Finals not attributed to him.

name: Larry Foust
summary: Strong rebounding center on Fort Wayne teams SI called the tightest defense in the league (1955); individual defense not described.

name: Charlie Scott
summary: High-volume scorer in Phoenix; no sources praise his defense; reputation as gunner.

name: Sidney Wicks
summary: Talented scorer/rebounder on poor Blazers teams; reputation for weak defensive effort, no defensive honors; little direct written evidence found.

name: George Yardley
summary: Hall of Fame bio calls him offensive-minded; scoring champion; rebounds well but no defensive praise.

name: Terrell Brandon
summary: Active hands (1.6-1.8 spg) in Fratello's slow, league-best points-allowed scheme; small PG, not known as stopper.

name: Jeff Hornacek
summary: Smart, steady guard with good hands; contemporary pieces focus on his shooting; not considered a stopper.

name: Bob Kauffman
summary: 1971 SI piece says defense was his one weakness, with Randy Smith covering for him.

name: Clifford Robinson
summary: Versatile, long frontcourt defender with ~1 blk/1 stl; later All-Defensive (2000, 2002) but not in this window.

name: Tree Rollins
summary: Elite shot blocker (~3 bpg) anchoring Fratello-era-precursor Hawks defense; All-Defensive honors came 1983-84.

name: Danny Ainge
summary: Scrappy, aggressive guard; assigned to Magic in 1987 Finals; never All-Defensive; viewed as competent pest rather than stopper.

name: Horace Grant
summary: Aggressive interior/help defender key to first three-peat; mobile in Bulls traps; All-Defensive honors started 1993.

name: Willie Naulls
summary: Scoring/rebounding forward on bad Knicks teams; no defensive praise in sources.

name: Mitch Richmond
summary: Doc Rivers (SI 1995): 'and he plays defense'; Jordan reportedly called him his toughest opponent; strong physical two-way SG.

name: Byron Scott
summary: Led champion Lakers in steals 1988 (1.9); described as good defender with quick switches and help; no honors.

name: Bill Sharman
summary: Celtics shooting guard known for shooting; pre-Russell Celtics weak defensively; no specific defensive accounts.

name: Dick Van Arsdale
summary: Physical, hard-nosed on-ball defender per recollections; All-Defensive 2nd team came later (1974).

name: Micheal Williams
summary: Pesky ballhawk; ~2.9 spg in 1991-92, second in NBA; All-Defensive honors per Wikipedia summary.

name: Nick Anderson
summary: Magic's primary wing defender, drew Jordan assignment in 1995 and famously stripped him; solid perimeter defender.

name: Walt Bellamy
summary: Huge scorer but contemporaries said he couldn't play defense well; criticized for lack of intensity/hustle.

name: Rolando Blackman
summary: Primarily scorer; Jordan reportedly called him a good defender; disciplined, never fouled out; later Mavs defensive coordinator.

name: Larry Costello
summary: Two-way PG known for defensive steadiness and hustle; evidence mostly from later career.

name: Vlade Divac
summary: Entered league as horrible defender, improved; savvy charge-taker/flopper, decent shot blocker; not a stopper.

name: Dale Ellis
summary: Pure shooter; Motta questioned his defense; not regarded as defender.

name: Larry Kenon
summary: Run-and-gun Spurs forward with good steals; claimed his defense was overlooked; Spurs were a poor defensive team.

name: Bob Love
summary: All-Defensive Second Team 1972 on Motta's defense-first Bulls.

name: Wes Unseld
summary: Defensive toughness, positional strength and rebounding anchored Bullets; widely praised defensively though undersized.

name: Paul Westphal
summary: All-NBA scorer; known for offense; no defensive honors in window (earlier Celtics reputation as quick defender).

name: Buck Williams
summary: Relentless rebounder and physical interior defender from rookie year; All-Defensive honors came later (1988-92).

name: Robert Horry
summary: Long, versatile forward used to bolster Rockets team defense; held his own vs Horace Grant in 1995 Finals; good help/blocks.
